stem: The photograph represents a result of which wartime policy?

options.label: A
options.text: A federal law that prohibited women from employment in factories

options.label: B
options.text: An executive order that prohibited employment discrimination in defense industries

options.label: C
options.text: A legislative act requiring all males to register for military service

options.label: D
options.text: A constitutional amendment that outlawed segregation in public accommodations

visual_elements: Black and white photograph titled 'Workers Manufacturing Artillery Shells, c. 1942' showing two workers operating a large industrial machine with a large stack of artillery shells in front of them.
